MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
QA Automation Engineer | CI/CD & Platform Engineering
Wroclaw, Poland | marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | GitLab: gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with experience spanning quality engineering, CI/CD pipelines, test environments and build tooling. Owns GitLab CI pipelines and has delivered faster builds, ephemeral Kubernetes test environments and test observability for multiple product teams. Also builds and monitors a personal k3s homelab, with hands-on Terraform experience provisioning a small Hetzner VPS.

CORE SKILLS
CI/CD: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose, Helm
Containers and orchestration: Kubernetes (namespace-level access; Helm deployments to shared cluster), k3s (personal homelab)
Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (personal Hetzner VPS); Ansible (basic)
Cloud: AWS (learning: EC2 and S3 basics)
Monitoring and data: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, PostgreSQL
Programming and scripting: Python, Bash, Java (test code), SQL
Testing: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman
Systems and tools: Linux, Git, Argo CD, Traefik, cert-manager

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software | Wroclaw | 2021-Present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (approximately 25 developers), covering builds, unit, integration and end-to-end tests, and artifact publishing.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes by parallelising test jobs, caching dependencies and separating end-to-end tests into their own stage; monthly CI runner costs fell by about 30%.
- Built short-lived merge-request test environments with Docker Compose and later Helm on the shared Kubernetes cluster; environments include the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data, and are automatically removed after merge or 48 hours of inactivity.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright end-to-end suite of approximately 900 tests; reduced the flaky-test rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Built Grafana dashboards for flaky tests using CI results, PostgreSQL and the GitLab API.
- Wrote Bash and Python tools for PostgreSQL test-data seeding and an internal CI guide used in onboarding.
- Mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House | Wroclaw | 2019-2021
- Tested web and mobile applications for client projects using manual and automated approaches.
- Introduced a Selenium and Java automated regression suite for the largest client project.
- Configured Jenkins jobs for nightly regression runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018-2019
- Investigated customer issues in logs and databases and reproduced bugs for developers.

SELECTED PROJECTS
Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal | 2024-2025
- Run a three-node Raspberry Pi 5 k3s cluster, deploying applications from a Git repository with Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki monitoring, Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS.
- Provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform; used Ansible at a basic level.

Merge-Request Ephemeral Environments | Odrava Health | 2023-2024
- Deployed a short-lived application and PostgreSQL environment with seeded data for each merge request, using GitLab CI and Helm on the shared Kubernetes cluster.
- Automatically removed environments after merge or 48 hours of inactivity; enabled QA and product reviews before merge and end-to-end testing against each environment.

CI Pipeline Speed-up | Odrava Health | 2022
- Profiled pipelines for three teams, parallelised test jobs, added dependency caching and separated end-to-end tests into their own stage.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner costs by about 30%.

Flaky Test Dashboard | Odrava Health | 2023
- Collected CI test results in PostgreSQL and built Grafana dashboards showing flaky tests by team.
- The flaky-test rate fell from 7% to below 1% after teams began addressing the leading causes.

EDUCATION
BEng, Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018

CERTIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) preparation | Exam booked for January 2027; not yet certified

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity role. My experience building CI/CD workflows and short-lived Kubernetes environments has given me a practical foundation in making software deployments repeatable, testable and easier for development teams to operate.

At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams and built merge-request environments using Helm on a shared Kubernetes cluster. By parallelising tests, adding dependency caching and restructuring pipeline stages, I reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner costs by about 30%. I have also built Grafana dashboards that helped teams identify flaky tests, and written internal CI documentation used in onboarding.

The opportunity to help shape infrastructure for Corvale's new train fleet is particularly interesting to me because the role combines reliable service delivery with the challenge of connecting onboard systems and backend services. Outside work, I run a three-node k3s homelab with GitOps, monitoring and TLS tooling, and have used Terraform to provision infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS.

To be clear about the scope of my current experience, my Terraform work has been in a personal environment; my AWS exposure is limited to learning EC2 and S3 basics, and I have not used Terragrunt. My professional Kubernetes work is focused on namespace-level access and Helm deployments to a cluster operated by a platform team. I would bring strong delivery and test-infrastructure experience, analytical problem-solving and clear documentation while continuing to develop my infrastructure engineering expertise.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience could contribute to Corvale's fleet connectivity platform.

Marta Kowal-Brandt
